bible_ref: non-biblical: framing — the Bible as the text of the revelation
topic: Raël told to read and bring the Bible
message_reading: The visitor says he telepathically prompted Raël to buy a Bible days earlier and instructs him to bring it to the next meeting; the Bible is framed as the document to be decoded.

bible_ref: non-biblical: history — France and democracy; first atomic explosion 1945
topic: Why France, why 1945
message_reading: France is chosen as the birthplace of democracy and land of freedom; the choice of a messenger was decided after the first atomic explosion of 1945.
distinctive_detail: Messenger chosen as 'trait d'union' between Jews and Catholics (Jewish father, Catholic mother); atomic age as trigger

bible_ref: non-biblical: scribal tradition / transmission of the Bible
topic: Bible distorted by copyists but meaning preserved
message_reading: The Bible preserves traces of the truth, distorted by copyists who could not conceive technology and attributed it to the supernatural; the law of copying without changing a single sign kept the deep meaning intact.
distinctive_detail: Only the translated parts matter; the rest is 'poetic chatter'

bible_ref: non-biblical: origin of the creators — lab-created life on the home planet
topic: Creators banned from genetic experiments at home
message_reading: On the distant planet scientists created life in test tubes; after an escaped creature caused deaths, the government banned experiments and the scientists moved them to Earth.
distinctive_detail: An escaped laboratory animal killed several people

topic: In the beginning Elohim created
message_reading: 'Elohim', wrongly translated 'God', is plural and means 'those who came from the sky'; 'created' really means they discovered/selected the Earth as suitable for artificial life.
distinctive_detail: Etymology: Elohim = 'ceux qui sont venus du ciel'

topic: Spirit of Elohim hovered over the waters
message_reading: The hovering spirit is reconnaissance flights and artificial satellites placed around Earth to study its composition and atmosphere; Earth was then covered entirely by water and thick mists.
distinctive_detail: Spirit over the waters = artificial satellites

topic: The light was good
message_reading: Studies established that the sun sent no harmful radiation to Earth's surface — the 'light was good'.

topic: Evening and morning — one day
message_reading: Each creation 'day' corresponds to the period during which the sun rises in the same sign at the spring equinox — about 2,000 terrestrial years.

topic: Firmament separating the waters above and below
message_reading: After studying cosmic radiation above the clouds, the creators descended below the clouds while staying above the sea: upper waters = clouds, lower waters = the world ocean.

topic: Gathering of the waters, appearance of dry land
message_reading: Strong explosions acted like bulldozers, lifting sea-floor material into one place and forming a single continent; modern science confirms the continents once fitted together.
distinctive_detail: Explosions created one original continent; continental drift cited as confirmation

topic: Vegetation according to its kind
message_reading: Plant cells were synthesized from chemicals in a planet-sized laboratory; research teams spread over the continent created different plants by climate and inspiration, with artists designing ornamental and fragrant plants.
distinctive_detail: Artists joined scientists to design decorative plants; reproduction was the key goal

topic: Luminaries as signs for seasons, days and years
message_reading: By observing stars and sun the creators measured Earth's days, months and years to regulate their lives on a planet with different day and year lengths.

topic: Sea creatures and birds
message_reading: Aquatic life was created from plankton to large fish with algae and predators to create a self-regulating balance (ecology); birds followed under pressure from artists, with extravagant plumage and mating dances; contests rewarded the most beautiful creations.
distinctive_detail: Bird colours and courtship dances designed by artists in competitions

topic: Monsters: dragons and dinosaurs
message_reading: Some teams created dreadful monsters — dragons, dinosaurs, brontosaurs — vindicating those at home who had opposed the experiments.
distinctive_detail: Dragons/dinosaurs as failed or monstrous creations

topic: Land animals according to their kind
message_reading: Herbivores were created first once vegetation was lush, then carnivores to balance them; the narrator says he himself is one of those who created life on Earth.
distinctive_detail: Speaker claims to be one of the creators

topic: Each human race = one team of creators
message_reading: Each team created a human being; the home planet, alarmed, required that the humans be kept primitive and the creators' actions mystified; each human race corresponds to one team of creators.
distinctive_detail: Number of creator teams = number of races

topic: Let us make man in our image
message_reading: Humans were made artificially in the literal physical image of the creators — 'the resemblance is striking'.
distinctive_detail: Plural 'let us make' and literal physical likeness

topic: Garden of Eden = laboratory in Israel
message_reading: The most brilliant team worked in what is now Israel (then near Greece and Turkey on the single continent); its domain was the 'earthly paradise' and its human the most intelligent, so measures were taken so the created would not surpass the creator.
distinctive_detail: Eden located in Israel on the single continent

topic: Tree of knowledge of good and evil
message_reading: The forbidden tree = scientific knowledge: humans could read any book except the scientific ones on pain of death.
search_terms_fr: arbre de la science du bien et du mal

topic: Adam names the animals
message_reading: The creators taught the humans botany and zoology — names and properties of living things — because that knowledge was not dangerous to them.
distinctive_detail: Naming = botany and zoology lessons; joyful scientists with two children

topic: The serpent tempts the woman
message_reading: The 'serpent' was a small group of creators who loved their creatures and wanted to give them full scientific education, saying they could be as strong as their creators.

topic: Their eyes were opened; they knew they were naked
message_reading: Adam and Eve understood they too could become creators and resented being treated as dangerous laboratory animals.

topic: Curse of the serpent
message_reading: The serpent-group was condemned by the home planet's government to exile on Earth, while the other creators had to stop their experiments and leave.
distinctive_detail: Serpent's curse = exile sentence on Earth

topic: Garments of skin
message_reading: The creators gave humans rudimentary means of survival before leaving them on their own; the verse is said to be nearly intact from the original document.
distinctive_detail: Verse claimed nearly intact from 'original document'

topic: Man has become like one of us; tree of life
message_reading: The tree of life is a scientific means of greatly extending life; longer-lived humans would quickly equal the creators. Israel was elected in a contest by the jury of creators as the most successful human type, explaining the 'chosen people'.
distinctive_detail: Chosen people = winners of the creators' scientific contest

topic: Cherubim and the flaming sword
message_reading: Soldiers with atomic disintegrating weapons were posted at the entrance of the creators' residence to stop humans stealing more scientific knowledge.

topic: Offerings of Cain and Abel
message_reading: The exiled creators, under military surveillance, encouraged humans to bring them food to prove to their superiors that their creatures were good and loyal.

topic: Longevity of the antediluvian patriarchs
message_reading: The exiles obtained that the leaders of the first humans benefit from the 'tree of life', explaining Adam's 930 years, Seth's 912, Enosh's 905.

topic: Sons of Elohim take the daughters of men
message_reading: The exiled creators took the most beautiful human daughters as wives.

topic: His days shall be 120 years
message_reading: Longevity was not hereditary: children did not automatically receive the 'tree of life', so the secret was lost and progress slowed.

topic: Heroes, men of renown (Nephilim offspring)
message_reading: Proof that creators could mate with human women and have exceptional children; scientific progress became so great that the home planet decided to destroy its creation.

topic: Wickedness of man
message_reading: 'Evil' meant the human desire to become equal to the creators, scientific and independent; 'good' meant remaining primitive.

topic: Flood by nuclear missiles; ark = spaceship
message_reading: The home planet sent nuclear missiles to destroy all life; the warned exiles had Noah build a 'rocket' orbiting Earth during the cataclysm; the 'pair of each species' was really one male and one female living cell per species from which whole beings could be reconstituted. A huge tidal wave submerged the continent.
distinctive_detail: Ark preserved cells, not animals; life kept a few thousand km above Earth

topic: The ark rose above the earth
message_reading: The text says the ark rose above the earth, not on the waters — then one had to wait for dangerous fallout to clear.
distinctive_detail: Lexical argument: 'above the earth' not 'on the waters'

topic: 150 days; ark in three stages
message_reading: The 'three-storey' ark was a three-stage rocket which landed back on Earth; aboard besides Noah was a couple of each human race.
search_terms_fr: inférieur, le second et le troisième

topic: Elohim remembered Noah; waters abate; animals released
message_reading: After monitoring and scientifically removing radioactivity, the creators had Noah release animals to test the atmosphere; Noah pledged a share of harvests and livestock to the creators.
distinctive_detail: Raven/dove episode read as atmosphere test; tithe instituted

topic: Noah's altar and the covenant
message_reading: The creators were pleased by humanity's goodwill and promised never again to try to destroy them, accepting their desire for progress as normal.
distinctive_detail: Covenant = creators' promise not to destroy

topic: The heart of man is evil
message_reading: The aim of man is scientific progress; each human race was returned to its place of creation and each animal recreated from cells preserved in the ark.
distinctive_detail: Recreation of animals from stored cells

topic: Nations spread after the Flood
message_reading: Quoted to mark the repopulation of the Earth by the nations after the Flood.

topic: Tower of Babel = rocket
message_reading: Israel, aided by the exiled creators, began space conquest and built an immense rocket — the Tower of Babel — to reach the creators' planet and win their pardon; the home planet was afraid, and realized life had not been destroyed.

topic: Confusion of languages and dispersion
message_reading: The creators took the scientifically knowledgeable Jews and scattered them among primitive tribes speaking other languages, and destroyed their scientific equipment.
distinctive_detail: Dispersal of Jewish scientists among primitive peoples

topic: Exiles pardoned; avengers in Sodom and Gomorrah
message_reading: The exiled creators were pardoned and returned home; some dispersed humans with surviving scientific secrets were preparing in Sodom and Gomorrah an expedition to punish their would-be destroyers; two spies were sent.
distinctive_detail: Sodom as base of vengeful scientists preparing an attack

topic: Two angels at Sodom; blinding
message_reading: The two 'angels' were spies; men who wanted to kill them were blinded with a pocket atomic weapon.

topic: Warning to flee; do not look back
message_reading: Peaceful inhabitants were warned to leave a city to be destroyed by an atomic explosion; they did not hurry, not understanding what an atomic explosion was.

topic: Fire and brimstone; Lot's wife pillar of salt
message_reading: A bomb fell on Sodom and Gomorrah; Lot's wife was killed by the burn of an atomic explosion, which makes close victims look like a statue of salt.
distinctive_detail: Pillar of salt = atomic burn victim

topic: Sacrifice of Isaac
message_reading: The creators tested whether Abraham, leader of a people fallen back into semi-primitive state after its 'brains' were destroyed, still had good feelings toward them; the test succeeded.

topic: Jacob's ladder
message_reading: Jacob's ladder with angels of Elohim ascending and descending is 'another description of our presence' — i.e. creators going up and down from a craft.
distinctive_detail: Ladder as trace of creators' craft/boarding

topic: Put away the foreign gods
message_reading: After the destruction of the most intelligent humans and centres like Sodom, people fell back into primitive idolatry of stones and idols, forgetting who created them.
distinctive_detail: Idolatry as amnesia of the creators

topic: The burning bush
message_reading: A rocket landed in front of Moses; its white light illuminated the trees without burning them, as a primitive in Brazil would describe a landing craft today.
distinctive_detail: Burning bush = landed craft's lights; Brazilian-primitive analogy

topic: Liberation of Israel to restore its dignity
message_reading: The chosen people, decapitated of its brightest minds, had become slaves of more numerous primitive neighbours; the creators had to free Israel and give back its country, guiding it to the destined land.

topic: Pillar of cloud by day and fire by night
message_reading: Yahweh (the creators' craft) went before the Israelites guiding them, as cloud by day and fire by night.

topic: Cloud moves behind Israel
message_reading: Smoke emitted behind Israel formed a screen that slowed down the pursuing Egyptians.

topic: Crossing of the Red Sea
message_reading: The crossing was achieved by a repulsing ray that cleared a passage through the water.

topic: Manna
message_reading: Manna was a synthetic chemical food sprayed onto the ground which the morning dew made swell.
distinctive_detail: Manna = sprayed synthetic food activated by dew

topic: Moses' staff brings water from the rock
message_reading: Moses' rod was a detector of underground water tables, like those used to find oil; once water was located, one simply dug.

topic: Laws dictated on Sinai
message_reading: Given Israel's primitive level it needed moral and above all hygienic laws, dictated to Moses on Mount Sinai by creators who descended in a flying machine.

topic: Theophany on Sinai: thunder, smoke, trumpet
message_reading: Thunder, lightning, heavy cloud, smoke like a furnace, trembling mountain and loudening horn describe a flying machine landing on the mountain.

topic: People forbidden to approach the mountain
message_reading: The creators feared being overrun by humans; they had to be respected, even venerated, to be safe, hence only Moses could approach.

topic: Sapphire pavement under God's feet
message_reading: The sapphire-like work was the pedestal on which a creator showed himself, made of the same bluish alloy as the floor of the craft Raël is sitting in.
distinctive_detail: Sapphire pavement = bluish metal alloy floor

topic: Glory of Yahweh like devouring fire
message_reading: The 'glory' was the creators' flying machine, which takes a fire-like colour at take-off (as Raël himself observed).

topic: Contributions of gold, silver, bronze, stones
message_reading: A team of creators staying on Earth wanted fresh food regularly and riches to take back home — 'a bit like colonisation'.

topic: Tabernacle / tent of meeting; face to face
message_reading: The tabernacle was a residence built to the creators' plans where human representatives met them and brought food and presents; Yahweh spoke with Moses face to face as man to man, as the visitor now speaks with Raël.
distinctive_detail: Tent of meeting = creators' residence; cloud at the tent's door

topic: No man can see my face and live
message_reading: Refers to atmospheric difference: on Earth creators must wear suits; a man coming to their planet would see them without suits but die because the atmosphere does not suit him.
search_terms_fr: ne peut me voir et vivre

topic: Offerings as food supply; blemished priests excluded
message_reading: Early Leviticus explains how food offered to the creators was to be brought for their supply; men with blemishes were excluded because sick or deformed humans were symbols of failure, unbearable to the creators.
distinctive_detail: Blemished = failed experiments, intolerable to creators

topic: Manna like coriander seed
message_reading: A very exact description of manna that chemists could reconstitute; but it was only chemical food, and the creators preferred fresh fruits and vegetables.

topic: First fruits to Yahweh
message_reading: The creators demanded first fruits — fresh produce — for themselves.

topic: Bronze serpent
message_reading: The creators taught humans to give injections against snakebites: the bitten person 'looked at' the bronze serpent while a syringe was brought and serum injected.

topic: Destroy idols and possess the land
message_reading: On the creators' advice the chosen people destroyed the idols of primitive tribes and occupied their territories.

topic: He chose their race after them
message_reading: The chosen people finally had its promised country, chosen because the creators loved its fathers.

topic: Crossing of the Jordan
message_reading: The creators let the people cross dry-shod using the same repulsor ray as at the Red Sea.

topic: Commander of Yahweh's army
message_reading: A military creator contacts the chosen people before the resistance of Jericho; a military adviser is sent.

topic: Trumpets of Jericho
message_reading: The walls fell by highly amplified ultrasound emitted in synchrony by a complex instrument the Bible calls 'trumpet' — as a soprano can crack a crystal glass.

topic: Great hailstones from heaven
message_reading: A real aerial bombardment that killed more than Israel's swords.

topic: Sun stands still
message_reading: One of the most distorted passages: the war was a blitzkrieg lasting only one day ('almost a whole day'); the conquest was so fast relative to the territory that men believed the sun had stopped.

topic: Gideon's offering consumed by fire from the rock
message_reading: Suited creators cannot eat in open air; by scientific means they extract the essential from offerings through a flexible tube (the 'staff'), feeding themselves; the operation emits flames that humans took for sacrifices to God.
distinctive_detail: Angel's staff = feeding tube; sacrifice fire = food-extraction process

topic: Gideon's 300 with trumpets
message_reading: The 300 men encircling the enemy camp used instruments emitting highly amplified ultrasound that drove the enemy mad, so soldiers killed one another and fled.

topic: Annunciation to Manoah's wife (Samson's conception)
message_reading: Another mating between creators and human women: the angel cured the woman's sterility and came to her when her husband was absent; the union gave creators sons ruling directly on Earth; abstinence from wine kept the child healthy for observation.
distinctive_detail: Angel fathered Samson in husband's absence

topic: Hair as telepathic antennae
message_reading: The brain is a transmitter of waves and thoughts (telepathy) needing antennae — hair and beard; hence not shaving those who must use it; scientists, prophets and sages often have long hair and beards.

topic: Samson the telepath
message_reading: Samson communicated with 'God' telepathically via his hair; when Delilah cut it he could no longer call for help, was blinded; when it regrew the creators brought down the temple whose columns he touched — attributed to his 'strength'.
distinctive_detail: Samson's strength = telepathic link to creators who toppled the temple

topic: Call of Samuel
message_reading: Eli initiates Samuel into telepathy: the creators try to contact Samuel, who thinks Eli is speaking; 'Speak, for your servant hears' is like radio amateurs saying 'I hear you loud and clear'.

topic: David and Goliath — the living God
message_reading: The phrase 'the living God' shows the reality at that time of a quite palpable 'God'.

topic: Ark of the covenant as transmitter-receiver
message_reading: Telepathy worked only when the Elohim were near Earth; otherwise they used a transmitter-receiver with its own atomic battery, carried in the 'ark of God'.

topic: Dagon fallen before the ark; Philistine tumours
message_reading: When the Philistines stole the ark, Dagon's idol fell on its face due to an electric discharge from mishandling; radioactive materials gave them burns ('tumours').
distinctive_detail: Dagon toppled by electrical discharge; bubons = radiation burns

topic: Uzzah struck dead touching the ark
message_reading: Uzzah touched a dangerous part of the apparatus while steadying it and was electrocuted.

topic: Grasping the horns of the altar
message_reading: Seizing the horns of the altar describes handling the levers of the transmitter-receiver to contact the creators.

topic: Solomon's Temple as first residence for the Elohim
message_reading: Solomon built a sumptuous residence to receive the creators on visits; 'Yahweh dwells in a cloud' means in a craft orbiting above the clouds.
distinctive_detail: Temple = first embassy; cloud = orbiting craft

topic: Man of God at Bethel; Jeroboam's withered hand
message_reading: A creator destroyed the altar with an atomic disintegrator and burned the hand of a disrespectful man, then returned to an Elohim earth-camp by another road so humans could not find it.
distinctive_detail: Return by different road to hide terrestrial bases

topic: Ravens feed Elijah
message_reading: An example of remote-guiding animals by electrode; the creators, appearing as little as possible, used discreet means like 'carrier ravens'. Start of a galaxy-scale experiment among competing humanities; prophets' authority reinforced by 'miracles' (incomprehensible scientific means).
distinctive_detail: Electrode-guided ravens; galactic competition among humanities

topic: Elijah revives the widow's son
message_reading: Elijah nursed and healed a dying child.

topic: Elijah vs prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel
message_reading: At a pre-arranged moment the pyre dedicated to the creators ignited, even drenched, thanks to a powerful laser-like ray from a ship hidden in the clouds.
distinctive_detail: Fire from heaven = laser from ship in clouds

topic: Angel feeds Elijah in the desert
message_reading: Elijah received attentive care from the creators: a cake and jar of water in the middle of the desert.

topic: Still small voice: wind, earthquake, fire
message_reading: An exact description of the landing of a craft comparable to modern rockets.
distinctive_detail: Theophany at Horeb = rocket landing sequence

topic: Micaiah sees Yahweh on his throne with host of heaven
message_reading: A description of the vision of the creators.

topic: Lying spirit in the mouths of the prophets
message_reading: The creators used group telepathy so that none of the prophets would tell the king the truth.

topic: Fire from heaven consumes the captains of fifty
message_reading: Proof of the creators' protection of Elijah; fire descended twice, and the third time the angel told Elijah to go down without fear.

topic: Elijah taken up in a whirlwind; chariot of fire
message_reading: Elijah was the creators' guest in a spaceship that took off and carried him away; the fire of the nozzles made the narrator speak of horses of fire, as primitives of South America or black Africa would describe a rocket launch.
distinctive_detail: Horses of fire = rocket exhaust flames

topic: Elisha revives the Shunammite's son
message_reading: A 'resurrection' through what is now common practice: mouth-to-mouth and heart massage to restart a stopped heart.

topic: Elisha feeds a hundred with twenty loaves
message_reading: The creators provided dehydrated synthetic food which, with water, grows fivefold; like astronauts' vitamin pills, twenty little 'loaves' feed a hundred men.
distinctive_detail: Arithmetic: one pill feeds one man, one loaf-volume five, twenty loaves a hundred

topic: Exile of Israel
message_reading: Israel worshipped metal idols, became cannibalistic and immoral, disgusting its creators; deportation began the dispersion and the regression of its civilization.

topic: Isaiah's vision of seraphim with six wings
message_reading: The seraphim are creators in autonomous spacesuits fitted with six small jets: two on the back, two at the hands, and two directional ones at the feet.
distinctive_detail: Six wings = six jet thrusters on spacesuits

topic: They come from a distant land, from the end of heaven
message_reading: 'The whole truth is described here': the hosts come 'from a distant country, from the ends of the sky' — could not be clearer.

topic: I will ascend to heaven above the stars; like the Most High
message_reading: Allusion to the lost scientists who had acquired enough knowledge to travel to the creators' planet and were destroyed at Sodom and Gomorrah; the destruction prevented man from equalling the 'Most High'.
distinctive_detail: Isaiah 14 (Lucifer passage) applied to the men of Sodom

topic: Cry around Moab; waters of Dimon full of blood
message_reading: The nuclear explosion (of Sodom/Gomorrah) is described further on.

topic: Enter your chambers and shut the doors
message_reading: Some survived by sheltering in bunkers ('blockhaus').

topic: Ezekiel's vision: cloud, fire, four living creatures
message_reading: The most interesting description of a flying craft: the great cloud is a high-altitude contrail, the 'flashing fire' and amber glow the craft and its blinking lamp; the four beings are creators in anti-gravity suits with small directional jets; their shining legs 'like burnished bronze' are metallic spacesuits.
distinctive_detail: Cloud = contrail; wings = suit thrusters; legs = shiny cosmonaut suits

topic: Ezekiel's wheels: wheel within a wheel, rims full of eyes
message_reading: The 'wheels' are flying saucers much like the one Raël sits in: 'wheel within a wheel' and 'did not turn as they went' describe them; the inhabited part is the 'rim', and the 'eyes' on the rims are portholes, used before the creators learned to see through metal walls by altering atomic structure.

topic: Crystal platform (firmament) and sapphire throne with a man
message_reading: The small saucers are service 'LEMs' with short range; above waits the large interplanetary vessel (the crystal platform), on which a man on a sapphire throne supervised and coordinated the creators' work.
distinctive_detail: Small saucers compared to Apollo LEMs; mother ship above

topic: Spirit of the creatures in the wheels; four faces
message_reading: Saucers stay near the creators while they gather materials and maintain the big intergalactic ship above; other creators inside pilot them ('the spirit of the beings was in the wheels'); the four faces are the four portholes of a helmet like early diving suits.
distinctive_detail: Four faces = four helmet portholes, like early diving suits
search_terms_fr: esprit des êtres était dans les roues

topic: Son of man, eat this scroll
message_reading: Like 'eating' from the tree of knowledge, it is intellectual nourishment: a book written on both sides — surprising when parchments were written on one side only; the knowledge of mankind's origin tastes sweet as honey.

topic: The spirit lifted me up; great rumbling
message_reading: Ezekiel is transported by the creators' craft to the place where he must spread the news; the rumble behind him is the craft.

topic: Carried between earth and heaven to Jerusalem
message_reading: Again the prophet is taken by a flying craft.

topic: Cherubim have human hands under their wings
message_reading: Ezekiel notes the cherubim have human hands under their 'wings' — i.e. they are men in flight suits.

topic: Cherubim rise from the earth with the wheels
message_reading: Description of creators and craft taking off together.

topic: Glory rises to the mountain east of the city; Ezekiel taken to Chaldea
message_reading: So many journeys for Ezekiel in one of the creators' flying craft.

topic: Valley of dry bones
message_reading: The creators resurrect men from bone remains: each particle contains all the information to reconstitute the being; a machine supplies the living matter while the particle provides the plan, as a spermatozoon carries hair and eye colour. Hence the ancient rite of protecting great men's tombs so they can be revived perpetually — part of the secret of the 'tree of life'.
distinctive_detail: Proto-cloning from bone; protected burials for future resurrection

topic: Very high mountain with a city; man like bronze
message_reading: The city is one of the creators' terrestrial bases, always on high mountains to avoid humans; the bronze-looking man wears a metallic spacesuit; because of the creators' small size they are taken for children — cherubs.
distinctive_detail: Creators' small stature explains 'chérubins' as children

topic: Priests leave their holy garments in the temple
message_reading: Priests serving the creators wore aseptic clothing that had to stay inside so as not to bring germs dangerous to the creators; it should have read 'sains' (healthy) not 'saints' (holy).

topic: Glory of the God of Israel comes from the east
message_reading: The big ship, respectfully called the 'glory of God', approaches with the sound of many waters.

topic: Closed east gate; the prince eats before Yahweh
message_reading: Only the 'prince' could meet the creators, who did not want to be disturbed; he had to enter through an airlock (the vestibule) where he was sterilized by special rays.

topic: Levitical priests serve; linen garments, nothing causing sweat
message_reading: Levite priests served the creators' table with fat and blood; they wore linen and nothing that makes one sweat because the smell of human sweat was very unpleasant to the creators.
distinctive_detail: Ban on sweat-inducing clothing = creators disliked human sweat odour

topic: Best of the first fruits to the priests
message_reading: Fresh-food supply of the creators continued in this way.

topic: Three men in the fiery furnace
message_reading: A creator came to their rescue in the fire with a repelling and refrigerating ray pushing back heat and flames; the 'fourth man like a son of the gods' was the creator.

topic: Daniel in the lions' den
message_reading: Nothing complicated: a small paralysing ray held the lions while Daniel was got out.

topic: Man clothed in linen, body like chrysolite
message_reading: Another interesting description of a creator (in a shining suit).
search_terms_fr: yeux comme des lampes de feu

topic: Michael with the kings of Persia; Persian and Greek domination
message_reading: Israel was dominated by Persians and Greeks because the creators, punishing its lack of faith, placed their own men ('angels') among those peoples to give them technical progress, explaining their civilizations' great moments; Michael headed the delegation to the Persians.
distinctive_detail: Angels as technical advisers seeding Persian and Greek civilizations

topic: Many who sleep in the dust shall awake
message_reading: The 'last judgement' will let great men live again: those positive for humanity who believed in the creators will be welcomed with joy; bad men will live in eternal shame as an example.

topic: The wise shall shine like the firmament
message_reading: Geniuses will be most esteemed and rewarded, and just men who allowed geniuses to flourish or truth to triumph will also be rewarded.

topic: Seal the book until the time of the end
message_reading: These words can only be understood once humanity reaches sufficient science — now; the end-time sign is the end of the scattering of the holy people, i.e. the creation of the State of Israel, coinciding with the scientific explosion; TV and space exploration make 'miracles' comprehensible.
distinctive_detail: Time of the end = founding of Israel (1948) + space age

topic: Jonah and the great fish
message_reading: The 'great fish' was a submarine; a real fish's gastric juices would have digested a man, and it would have needed aerophagia for him to breathe; inside, creators conversed with Jonah to keep informed of political events, then brought him to shore.
distinctive_detail: Whale = submarine; mock-physiological argument (gastric juices, aerophagia)

topic: Flying scroll twenty by ten cubits
message_reading: Another description of a flying craft, with dimensions converted to about 9 m by 4.5 m.

topic: Two women with stork wings
message_reading: First appearance of the creators' wives: two female companions in autonomous flight suits.

topic: Made a little lower than the Elohim
message_reading: Humans are almost as strong intellectually as their creators; copyists did not dare write 'equal to the Elohim' as had been dictated.
distinctive_detail: Claim of scribal alteration from 'equal' to 'a little lower'

topic: His going forth is from one end of heaven
message_reading: The creators came from a planet very far from Earth's orbit.

topic: He set a tent for the sun on the sea
message_reading: New allusion to the heap of earth created when the ocean covered the Earth, forming the original continent.
distinctive_detail: Reading 'tent on the sea' as primordial continent

topic: From heaven Yahweh looks on all mankind
message_reading: The creators watch humanity from their flying craft as they always have.

topic: Satan among the sons of Elohim; testing Job
message_reading: The sons of Elohim report regularly to the home planet; Satan belongs to the faction that always condemned creating intelligent beings so near, seeing them as a threat. The government gives Satan full powers to ruin Job, but not kill him, to test whether he loves his creators.
distinctive_detail: Satan = leader of the opposition faction on the home planet

topic: Spreading out skies solid as cast-metal mirror
message_reading: 'Solid clouds' are metallic flying machines, thought impossible to any but God; they now exist.

topic: Job restored
message_reading: Seeing Job's humility the creators healed him and restored his wealth, children and health.

topic: Raphael reveals himself
message_reading: Raphael was one of the creators' robots, sent to test human reactions; he left after proving who he was ('I did not eat or drink').
search_terms_fr: je ne mangeais ni ne buvais

topic: I will reveal what Wisdom is and how she came to be
message_reading: When the time comes 'wisdom' — the science that made all this possible — will be known to man; the biblical writings will be the proof.

topic: From the greatness of creatures one contemplates their author
message_reading: It was simple to see the truth: recognize the creators by observing the thing created.
distinctive_detail: Argument from design applied to Elohim

bible_ref: non-biblical: high-mountain civilizations (Himalaya, Peru) and undersea bases
topic: Creators' bases on high mountains and under the sea
message_reading: To avoid humans the creators had bases on high mountains where traces of high civilizations are now found (Himalaya, Peru) and on the sea floor; mountain bases were progressively replaced by undersea bases; the original banished creators hid under the oceans.
distinctive_detail: Peru/Himalaya ruins as creator bases; undersea bases

topic: Leviathan the fleeing serpent; the dragon in the sea
message_reading: Leviathan/the dragon in the sea = the banished creators (the 'serpent') hiding in undersea bases, whom the home-planet government then wanted to destroy.
distinctive_detail: Leviathan = exiled creators in submarine bases

topic: Book given to one who cannot read
message_reading: Humans have long held the truth but could not understand it until they 'knew how to read' — were scientifically evolved enough.

topic: Every man is brutish, lacking knowledge
message_reading: The science that let the creators create will let humans do the same.

topic: Wisdom as master-builder at creation
message_reading: Intelligence and science let the creators make dry land, the single continent and living beings; this intelligence now leads humans to repeat their creators' acts. Since the beginning of time men create men like themselves on other worlds — the cycle continues: 'we are your creators and you will create other men'.
distinctive_detail: Eternal cycle of creators creating creators

topic: What is has already been
message_reading: Supports the cyclical view: creation of humanity by humanity repeats endlessly.

topic: Man has no pre-eminence over the beast
message_reading: Animals too were created and will be recreated; extinct species can live again once humans learn to recreate them.

topic: Woe to the clay that quarrels with the potter; tested in the furnace of affliction
message_reading: The creators will show themselves officially only if humanity is grateful for its creation and loves them as fathers; fearing resentment, they let humans progress alone, almost without help.

bible_ref: non-biblical: Star of David and swastika (symbol on the craft)
topic: The emblem: Star of David with swastika
message_reading: The emblem on the craft and suit represents truth: the Star of David ('as above, so below', infinity in space) with a swastika at its centre (everything is cyclical, infinity in time); the origins and destiny of creators and humans are alike and linked; claimed to be the oldest symbol on the planet.
distinctive_detail: Hermetic 'as above, so below' attached to the hexagram; swastika as cyclicity
search_terms_fr: ce qui est en haut est comme ce qui est en bas

topic: Have you not understood the foundation of the earth? (second quotation)
message_reading: Re-quoted in the chapter on the end of the Church as a reproach to those who did not grasp the truth of origins.

topic: He who treads the heights of the earth
message_reading: Trace of the creators' bases on high mountains.

topic: Seven eyes of Yahweh; menorah
message_reading: The creators had seven bases; the seven-branched candlestick originally was a control panel at their HQ with seven indicator lights to stay in contact with the other bases and the orbiting interplanetary ship.

topic: Before a word is on my tongue you know it
message_reading: An allusion to telepathy, unimaginable at the time — 'knowledge too wonderful for me'.

topic: He counts the stars and names them
message_reading: Astronomy and interplanetary travel were unimaginable then.

topic: His word runs swiftly
message_reading: Telecommunication could not be understood at that time.

topic: Ruler from Bethlehem
message_reading: Turning point: the creators decide to let humans progress without direct intervention, having understood they themselves were created the same way; before that they send a 'Messiah' to spread worldwide what only Israel knew, announced in Micah.
distinctive_detail: Creators discover they were themselves created; non-intervention decision

topic: Your king comes humble, riding on a donkey
message_reading: Second prophecy announcing the Messiah who will dictate peace to the nations.
search_terms_fr: de la mer à la mer

topic: Virgin conception by the Holy Spirit; angel to Joseph
message_reading: The creators had a child born of a human woman and one of their own so that he would inherit telepathic faculties humans lack; Mary was the chosen Earth woman; a creator explained to her fiancé, who 'found the pill hard to swallow', that she carried a child of God.
distinctive_detail: Virgin birth = creator paternity for hereditary telepathy

topic: Star of Bethlehem guiding the Magi
message_reading: 'Prophets' in contact with the creators came from afar; one of the creators' flying craft served as their guide — the moving star that stopped above the child.

topic: Flight into Egypt and return
message_reading: The creators watched over the child, warning Joseph to flee from Herod, who disliked the 'child-king', and telling him when to return after Herod's death.

topic: Baptism (dove, voice) and temptation in the desert
message_reading: When grown, Jesus was taken by the creators to learn who he was, meet his Father, learn his mission and be initiated into scientific techniques; the devil 'Satan' — the sceptical creator backed by the opposition — tested whether his intelligence was positive and he loved the creators.
distinctive_detail: Temptation = Satan's aptitude test; baptism = initiation by creators

topic: Jesus heals the sick
message_reading: To rally the people he performed 'miracles' — really applying scientific teachings from the creators.

topic: Blessed are the poor in spirit
message_reading: Wrongly translated: the original meant 'the poor, if they have spirit (wit), will be happy'.

topic: Lord's Prayer: on earth as in heaven
message_reading: Taken literally: in 'heaven', on the creators' planet, scientists ended up ruling and created other intelligent beings; the same will happen on Earth — the torch will be taken up.
distinctive_detail: 'On earth as in heaven' = Earth will repeat the creators' history
search_terms_fr: sur la terre comme au ciel

topic: He taught as one having authority
message_reading: Jesus had been taught to speak persuasively through a form of telepathic group hypnosis.

topic: Healing the leper and the paralytic
message_reading: Healings were done with the creators' help at a distance by concentrated rays, laser-like but burning at a single point through layers.

topic: Not the righteous but sinners
message_reading: Jesus came not for Israel, which knew of the creators, but so the knowledge would spread through the world.

topic: Miracles were medical
message_reading: All later miracles were medical; heart transplants, curing leprosy, reviving from coma would seem miracles to primitive tribes today; the creators then were like today's 'civilized' nations but more advanced.

topic: My Father who is in heaven
message_reading: 'Everything is said here': Jesus' real father is among the creators, physically 'in the heavens' — not an immaterial God; incomprehensible to people believing stars were lamps on a vault around a central Earth.
distinctive_detail: Literal 'Father in heaven'; critique of geocentric cosmology
search_terms_fr: mon père qui est dans les cieux

topic: Parable of the sower — parallel humanities
message_reading: The sower = creators leaving their planet to create life elsewhere. Four attempts: birds = opponents destroyed a creation too near the home planet; rocky ground = planet too close to a hot sun; thorns = too-humid planet where vegetation took over (that all-plant world still exists); good soil = success. Three successes mean two other relatively nearby planets host humans made by the same creators.
distinctive_detail: Parable as record of four planetary experiments; three inhabited worlds; surviving vegetable world

topic: He who has ears; to him who has more shall be given
message_reading: Those who prove their intelligence will be helped by the creators; peoples who fail will be destroyed; humans lack only love, among themselves and toward their creators.
search_terms_fr: on donnera à celui qui a

topic: Mysteries of the kingdom of heaven
message_reading: The three planets with life are in competition; the one making the greatest scientific progress, without aggression toward the creators, will receive their inheritance on the 'last judgement' day.
distinctive_detail: Interplanetary competition for the creators' inheritance

topic: Mustard seed; birds nest in its branches
message_reading: Human genius is the smallest seed becoming a tree; the 'birds of heaven' = creators who will come 'nest' and bring knowledge once humans are worthy.

topic: Leaven in three measures of flour
message_reading: New allusion to the three worlds where the creators await scientific blossoming.

topic: Things hidden since the foundation of the world
message_reading: Planets have a life span and become uninhabitable; humans must by then be able to move to another planet or create a humanoid adapted to another world to inherit their knowledge; the creators put life on three worlds so the inheritance is not lost.
distinctive_detail: Create man adapted to the environment if the environment cannot be adapted
search_terms_fr: caché depuis la fondation du monde

topic: At the end of the age angels separate the wicked from the just
message_reading: Only the best of the three worlds will have the right to the inheritance.

topic: Multiplication of loaves (Jesus); hosts
message_reading: Already explained: concentrated food in big pills like astronauts', containing all vital principles — hence communion hosts shaped like pills; a few loaves' worth feeds thousands.
distinctive_detail: Communion wafer derived from food-pill shape

topic: Walking on water; the wind ceased
message_reading: The creators supported Jesus with an anti-gravitational ray cancelling gravity at a precise point; it created turbulence ('the wind') which ceased when the ray stopped as he entered the boat. 'There are no miracles, only gaps between civilizations.'

topic: No miracles, only civilizational lag
message_reading: A modern person arriving in Jesus' time with a helicopter, electric light, a car, TV or a rifle would work 'miracles'; the same gap exists between the creators and today's humans; there is no immaterial God, only men who created other men in their image.

topic: Transfiguration with Moses and Elijah
message_reading: The scene took place at night: Jesus lit by the powerful searchlights of a flying craft from which Moses and Elijah emerged, still alive thanks to the 'tree of life'; immortality is a scientific reality.
distinctive_detail: Moses and Elijah still alive via life extension; searchlights

topic: The first shall be last
message_reading: Means the created will become creators, as the creators were created.

topic: Parable of the talents
message_reading: The three planets must make scientific progress and will be judged: the world that progresses most receives the inheritance; the one that does not will be dominated and annihilated — also true among nations on Earth.

topic: Put back your sword; twelve legions of angels; scriptures fulfilled
message_reading: Jesus had to die so the truth would spread and the scriptures bear witness, so that when the creators return they will not be taken for usurpers or invaders — that is the use of the biblical and gospel writings.
distinctive_detail: Scripture's purpose = recognition of returning creators

topic: Angel rolls away the stone; resurrection
message_reading: Jesus, once dead, 'resurrects' with the creators' help: they treat and revive him; the angel was dazzling like lightning.

topic: Great Commission
message_reading: Jesus commands the apostles to make disciples of all nations; his mission ends.

topic: Ascension
message_reading: The creators took Jesus away after his last words.

topic: They will take up serpents, drink poison, heal the sick
message_reading: Prophecy of the time when humans know antivenom serum, antidotes and surgery — now.

topic: Parable of the fig tree — signs of the times
message_reading: Before returning, the creators make increasingly frequent appearances; when UFOs appear in profusion, as now, the times have come.

topic: Pentecost: tongues of fire, speaking in other languages
message_reading: The creators imprinted other languages in the apostles' memory by condensed teaching via amplified telepathic waves applied in an electroshock-like form, so they could spread the truth.

topic: Angel frees Peter from prison
message_reading: Peter, a primitive, thought he was having a vision as his chains fell; he did not know the laser electronic torch the creator used; witnesses of creators are often said to have had 'visions' or dreams, as UFO witnesses are said to hallucinate — here it is clearly said it was real.
distinctive_detail: Chains cut by laser torch; 'vision' as misdescribed reality

topic: I will rebuild the fallen tent of David
message_reading: Another sign of the times: Israel has recovered its country.

topic: We are his offspring
message_reading: Said of God by an apostle: humans are of the creators' race. Many further allusions remain in the New Testament for Raël to translate himself.

bible_ref: Matthew 24; 13:39–49 (end of the world / end of the age)
topic: End of the world = end of the Church
message_reading: The 'end of the world' has come — not a planetary catastrophe but the end of the world of the Church, which completed its popularizing mission (letting the creators be recognized when they come) with many errors, chiefly deifying the creators.
distinctive_detail: Apocalypse reinterpreted as institutional collapse of the Church

bible_ref: non-biblical: popular Christian imagery (white-bearded God, guardian angels, horned devil)
topic: Collapse of belief in the bearded God on a cloud
message_reading: People of scientifically developed countries can no longer believe in the white-bearded 'good God' on a cloud, cute guardian angels or the devil with horns and hooves; hence their moroseness.

bible_ref: non-biblical: astrology/precession — Age of Pisces and Age of Aquarius
topic: Pisces = Christ and his fishermen; Aquarius since 1946
message_reading: Everything happens now that Earth has entered the sign of Aquarius; the plan has been foreseen since the creators began their work 22,000 years ago, as galactic motion permits; Pisces was Christ and his fishermen, Aquarius began in 1946 when Israel recovers its land.
distinctive_detail: Aquarius dated to 1946 (Raël's birth year); 22,000-year programme

topic: Clamour from the Fish Gate
message_reading: The 'Fish Gate' is the passage into the new age of Aquarius — the sun rising at the spring equinox 'in' Aquarius; the clamour is the noise this revelation will make; being born in 1946 is no accident.
distinctive_detail: Fish Gate = exit from the Age of Pisces

topic: End of those who make man guilty
message_reading: End of those who teach original sin and make man guilty, and who set traps for the one spreading the truth at the 'Gate' of Pisces (entry into Aquarius) — like those who crucified Jesus at the passage into Pisces.
distinctive_detail: Original-sin preachers; parallel between Jesus at Pisces and Raël at Aquarius

topic: Eyes of seers no longer closed; the fool and the knave
message_reading: Everyone will understand; the Church is the fool who utters aberrations about Yahweh and leaves empty those hungry for truth, keeping the simple loyal through fear of sin and excommunication; the 'noble' is the one who will loudly proclaim the truth.

topic: Behold my servant, my chosen
message_reading: The servant who will make judgement known to the nations is Raël, who will spread the truth revealed to him.

topic: He will not break the bruised reed nor quench the dimly burning wick
message_reading: Raël will not destroy the Church; it will die out by itself — 'the wick is fading'. Its errors: too much supernatural, translating plural 'Elohim' (plural of Eloha) as singular 'God', and having people worship a cross.

topic: Shall I worship a block of wood?
message_reading: Applied to the cross: a piece of crossed wood means nothing; a cross is not Christ.

topic: I will gather your seed from east and west
message_reading: The return of the Jews to Israel is a sign of the golden age: the creation of the State of Israel receiving Jews from north and south.

topic: You are my witnesses
message_reading: The Bible, preserved by the Jewish people, serves as testimony to the creators' coming; 'today also I am the same' — said again by the visitor thanks to the Bible's testimony.
distinctive_detail: Jews as witnesses via preserved scripture

topic: For a brief moment I forsook you
message_reading: Israel has indeed recovered its country after taking part in safeguarding the truth.

topic: No more infant who lives but a few days
message_reading: Predicts the time when science dominates disease; medicine now triumphs over illness, especially infant mortality.

topic: Wisdom on the lips of the intelligent
message_reading: Quoted in support of the intelligent understanding the revelation.

topic: Do not babble prayers like the pagans
message_reading: The Church sinned by making man guilty and making him pray without seeking to understand.

topic: God and Mammon; no gold or silver
message_reading: Despite the Gospels the Church grew too rich; how dare men lounge in the Vatican's luxury when the Gospel forbids gold, silver, even a second tunic; 'Mammon' glossed as Aramaic for wealth.

topic: Not what enters the mouth defiles
message_reading: With 'stupid rules' and meatless Fridays the Church did not respect its own Gospel.
search_terms_fr: ce qui entre dans la bouche

topic: Hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom
message_reading: Further charge against the Church's wealth.

topic: Call no man father; heavy burdens
message_reading: The Church burdens men with so-called sins that are merely differences of mores, lives in opulence, seeks honours, has itself called 'father', 'eminence', 'holiness' against its own Gospel; if the Pope took to the road with a beggar's bag the Church would revive; the Vatican should sell its riches for underdeveloped nations; tiered marriages and funerals by wealth are another error. Believers were right about the substance of the scriptures but wrong to support the Church.
distinctive_detail: Pope with a beggar's bag; Vatican should sell its riches

bible_ref: non-biblical: Kabbalah — Shi'ur Qomah measurements (attached to Song of Songs 5)
topic: Height of the creator 236,000 parasangs; heels 30 million parasangs
message_reading: The Kabbalah is the book closest to the truth; its description (in connection with the Song of Songs 5) of the creator's 'height' (236,000 parasangs) and 'heel height' (30 million parasangs) encodes the creators' planet: a parasang equals one light-second (~300,000 km); the planet is ~9 trillion km away (just under a light-year) and 70.8 billion km from its sun. The Elohim travel in under two months riding 'rays' seven times faster than light, which is why their craft turn white then blue and vanish.
distinctive_detail: Parasang redefined as light-second; FTL travel explains observed colour changes

bible_ref: non-biblical: other religions and mythologies (Andes, Himalaya, Greek mythology, Buddhism, Islam, Mormons)
topic: Traces in almost all religions
message_reading: Almost all religious books allude to the creators more or less clearly, especially where they had bases — the Andes, the Himalaya, Greece (whose mythology contains great testimonies) — and Buddhism, Islam, the Mormons, and many sects.

topic: Evolution is a myth: evolution of creation techniques
message_reading: Evolutionists are not entirely wrong — life began single-celled and became more complex — but not by chance: the creators progressed from simple life to fish, amphibians, mammals, birds, primates and finally man, 'an improved ape model' made in their image as Genesis says. Decorative traits (spiral horns, bird colours) are the work of the creators' artists; prehistoric skulls are early human prototypes superseded by better ones; Satan still thinks humans are too intelligent.
distinctive_detail: Hominid skulls = discarded prototypes; antelope spiral horns as art

bible_ref: Genesis 19 (Sodom and Gomorrah, as future threat)
topic: A new Sodom and Gomorrah
message_reading: If human aggressiveness is not curbed and warmongers stay in power, the creators will prevent humanity from becoming a danger to them: it will be a new 'Sodom and Gomorrah', destroying civilization and its scientific centres.
distinctive_detail: Sodom as template for future punitive strike

bible_ref: non-biblical: Hebrew onomastics — the name Raël (and Ramuel)
topic: Raël = light of the Elohim; messenger
message_reading: 'Raël' literally means 'light of God', more precisely 'light of the Elohim', 'the one who brings the light of the Elohim', 'ambassador of the Elohim', or simply 'messenger'; his son's name Ramuel means 'son of the one who brings the light'.

bible_ref: non-biblical: history — Copernicus condemned by the Church
topic: Copernicus and the incapable majority
message_reading: Copernicus was condemned by an incapable majority because he alone understood that the Earth was not the centre of the world as the Church believed; used to argue against universal suffrage and against scientists who dismiss UFOs.
distinctive_detail: Copernicus (not Galileo) as the condemned figure

bible_ref: Leviticus 25:8–23 (Jubilee); allusion to equality and 'the land is mine'
topic: Jubilee: 49-year leases replace property
message_reading: 'You are born equal' and 'this world is not yours, you are only tenants' are said to be in the Bible; property and inheritance should be abolished (except the family home) and all goods leased for 49 years — 'humanitarianism', already prescribed in the Jubilee laws.
distinctive_detail: Jubilee as blueprint for 49-year state leases

topic: Why the visitor no longer wears a spacesuit
message_reading: The Elohim no longer need the suits seen by Ezekiel: the visitor's face is protected by an invisible suit of repulsor rays that let waves through but not air molecules, like bubble curtains used in ports against oil slicks.

topic: Women and children on the creators' planet
message_reading: Asked whether they have women, the visitor refers back to the biblical passage he had Raël note (Zechariah's winged women); they have children exactly like humans.

bible_ref: Genesis 3:22; Genesis 5 (tree of life, patriarchal longevity)
topic: Tree of life = small surgical operation
message_reading: The biblical 'tree of life' is a small surgical intervention letting Elohim live ten times longer than humans — 750 to 1,200 years — 'like the first men of the Bible'; two parents, two children keeps their population constant.
distinctive_detail: Tree of life = surgery; matches antediluvian ages

topic: Eternity by cloning; council of the eternals' 'last judgement'
message_reading: From a preserved cell the body is recreated with memory and personality intact; after each year's deaths a great council of the eternals holds a 'last judgement' to decide who deserves another life; three lives as probationer before permanent membership.
distinctive_detail: Last judgement = annual council deciding re-creation

topic: Call us Elohim — 'those who came from the sky'
message_reading: Though they call themselves 'men', humans may call them 'Elohim' since they 'came from the sky'.

topic: Their official language is close to ancient Hebrew
message_reading: The official language of the creators' planet closely resembles ancient Hebrew.
distinctive_detail: Hebrew as near-descendant of the creators' language

topic: Moses, Elijah and Jesus alive on the creators' planet
message_reading: In a residence reproducing Earth's atmosphere live several humans including Moses, Elijah and Jesus Christ, who can be brought back in due time; not yet, because a returning Christ would be put in an asylum, and scientific prodigies would revive supernatural religion.
distinctive_detail: Returning Christ would be committed to an asylum
